title: Prevent nested Work Item context leakage
rawUserRequest: WI-10 完整质量门暴露出流程缺陷：外层 make ai-finish 的 Work Item 变量污染临时 adopter 仓库中的嵌套 finish。先修流程并增加脚本检查，完成独立 PR、合并、关闭和分支清理，再继续 WI-10；没有新的确认事项时继续执行。

declaredIntent.summary: Prevent outer Work Item identity variables from leaking into nested Make subprocesses and add regression coverage for the real propagation path.

outOfScope: Changing Make targets, verification requirements, or quality thresholds
Release metadata, tags, assets, or provider publication
Unrelated process RFEs scheduled after the WI-01 through WI-20 audit

sources.reason: WI-10 quality evidence showing nested e2e and adopter finish commands resolve the outer WI-10 Contract.
Defines clean_git_environment and the Work Item Make-variable blocklist used by nested governance subprocesses.
Existing regression covers MAKEOVERRIDES filtering but not direct top-level environment entries.
Requires process defects to be corrected with executable evidence before delivery resumes.

riskAssessment.reason: Leaked Work Item identity can validate the wrong Contract or make adopter lifecycle checks fail for unrelated outer state.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized process-first correction, complete PR lifecycle, and continued execution without another pause when no new decision is needed.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm direct environment entries and encoded MAKEFLAGS/MAKEOVERRIDES entries are all sanitized.
Confirm project quality overrides remain available to nested fixture checks.
Confirm the fix is exercised under an outer CONTRACT value rather than only by a unit helper assertion.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A regression test reproduces that direct CONTRACT, SUMMARY, TASK, TITLE, MODE, and AI_BASE_COMMIT environment entries survive the current sanitizer.
clean_git_environment removes Work Item identity variables both as direct environment entries and from MAKEFLAGS or MAKEOVERRIDES while preserving project quality overrides.
The finish lifecycle e2e runs successfully when pytest itself is launched with an unrelated outer CONTRACT value.
Full local quality, archive, committed PR validation, hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, branch deletion, and synchronized main complete before WI-10 resumes.
guidelines: Fix the context at the shared subprocess environment boundary rather than weakening individual fixture assertions.
Preserve explicitly supported project quality overrides used by nested checks.
Add executable regression evidence for the actual outer-to-inner propagation path.

intent.problem: During WI-10 full quality, three independent lifecycle tests invoked ai-finish inside temporary repositories. Their check-ai-guards steps unexpectedly resolved the outer WI-10 Contract path, which does not exist inside those repositories. clean_git_environment filters blocked names only inside MAKEFLAGS and MAKEOVERRIDES but copies the same names when they are direct environment entries.
constraints: Deliver this workflow defect as one isolated corrective Work Item and PR.
Do not mix WI-10 documentation edits or release work into the corrective.
Do not remove project quality overrides that tests intentionally propagate.
Use test-first red-green evidence and complete lifecycle cleanup before resuming WI-10.
intent.rationale: Sanitizing the shared nested-subprocess boundary prevents every current and future fixture from inheriting a foreign Work Item identity, while one regression under a real outer Contract proves the end-to-end path.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A nested finish runs while the outer process exports a different Work Item Contract and Summary.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The nested repository resolves only its own task Contract and completes its lifecycle checks.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: First run the focused e2e with an outer CONTRACT to reproduce the wrong path, then implement the shared sanitizer fix and rerun the same command.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Project-specific quality command overrides are present beside blocked Work Item identity variables.
scenarioCoverage.expected: PROJECT_TEST, PROJECT_FORMAT_CHECK, and PROJECT_LINT remain available while Work Item identity variables are absent.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend the sanitizer unit regression with direct and encoded variables, then run the focused helper and finish e2e tests.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
